# LLM Pricing Comparison

> A regularly updated comparison of pricing, context length, and capabilities for 91+ large language model APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Alibaba. All prices are in USD per 1 million tokens.

Source: https://llmpricing.dev
Last updated: 2026-07-19
